# .github Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
3D Animated Professional Portfolio website built with React, Three.js, and Framer Motion.

## Development Checklist
- [x] Project structure created
- [x] Dependencies configured (package.json)
- [x] TypeScript configuration
- [x] Tailwind CSS setup
- [x] React components built
- [x] 3D animations implemented
- [ ] Install dependencies and start dev server
- [ ] Verify all sections render correctly
- [ ] Test responsive design
- [ ] Optimize performance

## Key Technologies
- React 18 + TypeScript
- Three.js (R3F)
- Framer Motion
- Tailwind CSS
- Vite

## Portfolio Sections
1. Hero - 3D animated intro
2. About - Professional summary
3. Experience - Work history
4. Skills - Technical expertise
5. Education - Academic background
6. Contact - Connection options

## To Deploy
After development:
1. Run `npm run build`
2. Deploy dist/ folder to Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages
